name: Lifesum
title: lifesum.com
shortDescription: Lifesum is a digital health platform that helps users manage their diet and nutrition through AI-driven tools. It offers personalized meal plans, nutrition tracking, and dietary advice tailored to individual lifestyles and health goals. Users can log meals via photos, voice, or barcode scanning for a seamless experience.
cons: Potential privacy concerns with data handling

aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Offers fasting plans and detailed food analysis
